wuhan-2025.notes: QOJ dashboard (source 2) is the Universal Cup stage 'The 4th Universal Cup. Extra Stage 2: Wuhan', marked as also known as the 2025 ICPC Asia Wuhan Regional Contest; the earlier login-page copy has been replaced. The 13 statement PDFs (QOJ problem ids 14719-14731) carry no letter or contest name; letters assigned from the dashboard's list. The editorial cover date 2 November 2025 is not taken as the contest day; no source here prints the contest date.

sources.disagreement: The earlier reader saw a QOJ login page; our copy has since been replaced and is now the contest dashboard with the full problem list.
